authority_classes.definition: Primary or delegated law, binding precedent, or other source whose legal effect binds within a stated jurisdiction and temporal context.
authority_classes.label: Binding legal authority

authority_classes.definition: Legal reasoning or decisions that may influence but do not bind the deciding body in the matter.
authority_classes.label: Persuasive authority

authority_classes.definition: Rules, practice directions, forms, fees and operational requirements governing legal process.
authority_classes.label: Procedural material

authority_classes.definition: Regulatory rulebooks, directions, determinations and schemes made under delegated competence.
authority_classes.label: Delegated administrative rules

authority_classes.definition: Official statements explaining policy, interpretation, enforcement or compliance; force depends on statutory basis and context.
authority_classes.label: Official interpretation or guidance

authority_classes.definition: Bills, debates, explanatory material, law-reform work, inquiry material and records evidencing development or intent.
authority_classes.label: Legislative and judicial history

authority_classes.definition: Official information helping users access courts, tribunals, legal aid, forms, listings and public legal assistance.
authority_classes.label: Legal-service information

authority_classes.definition: Non-authoritative or contextual information, including secondary databases and professional commentary.
authority_classes.label: Commentary or contextual material

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Acts, Measures and equivalent primary enactments, including devolved legislatures.
classes.label: Primary legislation
classes.minimum_provenance: Work identity, enacted and revised expressions, territorial extent, commencement and point-in-time state.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Statutory instruments, rules, orders, regulations and other delegated instruments.
classes.label: Secondary and delegated legislation
classes.minimum_provenance: Enabling power, making/laying/coming-into-force dates, version and extent.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Bills and draft statutory instruments before enactment or making.
classes.label: Draft legislation and draft instruments
classes.minimum_provenance: Stage, version, sponsor, amendments and explicit non-operative status.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Original, revised and point-in-time expressions and manifestations.
classes.label: Historical and revised legislation versions
classes.minimum_provenance: Exact version date, revision status, source manifestation and unapplied effects.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Legal-effect relationships between instruments and provisions.
classes.label: Amendment, commencement, repeal and extent effects
classes.minimum_provenance: Affecting/affected identifiers, effect type, date, extent and application status.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: EU-origin law preserved or transformed in domestic law, plus related withdrawal instruments.
classes.label: Retained and assimilated EU law
classes.minimum_provenance: UK status, cut-off date, domestic amendments, EU source identity and dual licence.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Local Acts, private Acts, byelaws and local schemes.
classes.label: Local and private legislation
classes.minimum_provenance: Making body, enabling power, confirmation/local procedure, geographic extent and current status.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Treaties and instruments creating or evidencing international obligations.
classes.label: Treaties and international instruments
classes.minimum_provenance: Treaty series, parties, signature/ratification/entry into force, reservations and depositary status.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Published judgments from courts, with binding force determined by court hierarchy and issue.
classes.label: Court judgments
classes.minimum_provenance: Court, neutral citation, handed-down date, judges, version, appeal status and selected passage.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Published tribunal decisions; precedential force varies by chamber and appellate level.
classes.label: Tribunal decisions
classes.minimum_provenance: Tribunal/chamber, citation, panel, date, appeal status and jurisdiction.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Orders, concurrences, dissents and other judicial outputs distinct from the main judgment.
classes.label: Orders, opinions and separate reasons
classes.minimum_provenance: Relationship to proceeding and judgment, author, operative status and version.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Identifiers linking a decision to official neutral citation and report series.
classes.label: Neutral and report citations
classes.minimum_provenance: Source-assigned citation, report reference, parallel citations and mapping provenance.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Cites, follows, applies, distinguishes, doubts, disapproves, overrules and appeal relationships.
classes.label: Precedent, citation and judicial treatment
classes.minimum_provenance: Passage-level evidence, source/target identity, treatment verb, direction, court and date.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Court, tribunal, chamber, judge, jurisdiction and competence records.
classes.label: Court and tribunal reference data
classes.minimum_provenance: Stable institutional identity, hierarchy, temporal existence and competence source.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Civil, criminal, family and tribunal procedure rules.
classes.label: Court and tribunal rules
classes.minimum_provenance: Rule version, amendment instrument, commencement, applicability and official passage.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Practice directions, pre-action protocols and judicial procedural instructions.
classes.label: Practice directions and protocols
classes.minimum_provenance: Issuing authority, effective date, amendment history, applicable rules and exceptions.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Official forms, fee orders, calculators and process guidance.
classes.label: Forms, fees, deadlines and procedural guidance
classes.minimum_provenance: Form revision, fee date, deadline basis, jurisdiction and accessibility.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Definitive and consultative sentencing guidelines and ancillary materials.
classes.label: Sentencing guidelines
classes.minimum_provenance: Guideline version, offence, effective date, statutory duty and applicability.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: CPS, COPFS, PPSNI and regulator enforcement guidance.
classes.label: Prosecution and enforcement guidance
classes.minimum_provenance: Issuer, version, legal basis, policy status, effective date and exceptions.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Regulator rulebooks, handbooks, standards, directions and binding requirements.
classes.label: Regulatory handbooks and rules
classes.minimum_provenance: Regulator competence, rule version, legal instrument basis, effective dates and territorial scope.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Final notices, decisions, undertakings, penalties, permissions and appeals.
classes.label: Regulatory decisions and enforcement notices
classes.minimum_provenance: Decision-maker, subject, statutory power, date, outcome, appeal/review state and redactions.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Statutory and non-statutory codes, manuals and guidance.
classes.label: Codes of practice and statutory guidance
classes.minimum_provenance: Statutory basis, duty to have regard, version, audience and legal-force qualification.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Published findings, decisions, recommendations and adjudications.
classes.label: Ombudsman and adjudicator decisions
classes.minimum_provenance: Scheme jurisdiction, binding/recommendatory status, retention window, anonymity and review route.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Bills, amendments, stages, debates, votes, committee material and deposited papers.
classes.label: Parliamentary materials and Hansard
classes.minimum_provenance: House, session, stage, date, speaker, bill version and stable passage anchor.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Official explanatory and impact material associated with legislation or bills.
classes.label: Explanatory notes and impact assessments
classes.minimum_provenance: Associated work, publisher, date, version, explicit non-authoritative role and passage.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Law Commission and equivalent consultation papers, reports, draft Bills and implementation status.
classes.label: Law-reform publications
classes.minimum_provenance: Project, report number, date, recommendations, government response and implementation links.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Inquiry reports, evidence, rulings and official accident or investigation reports.
classes.label: Public inquiries and official investigations
classes.minimum_provenance: Statutory basis, chair/body, module, evidence provenance, publication and recommendation status.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Eligibility, scope, calculators, provider finding and public advice routes.
classes.label: Legal aid and public legal assistance
classes.minimum_provenance: Jurisdiction, eligibility date, disclaimer, service owner and referral limits.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Statutory notices, insolvency, planning, appointments and other public legal notices.
classes.label: Public notices and official gazettes
classes.minimum_provenance: Notice code, publication date, issuer, geographic scope, permanent URI and digital signature.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Bodies, offices, powers, competence, geographic remit and organisational lineage.
classes.label: Jurisdiction, institution and public-body reference data
classes.minimum_provenance: Authoritative source, temporal identity, statutory basis, aliases and successor/predecessor.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Court and tribunal listings, venues, hearing times and case references.
classes.label: Legal-service listings and hearing data
classes.minimum_provenance: Licence, time sensitivity, suppression/anonymity, source timestamp and access restrictions.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: EUR-Lex/CELLAR law, case law and preparatory acts relevant to UK legal interpretation or history.
classes.label: European Union legal sources
classes.minimum_provenance: CELEX/ECLI/ELI identity, language, consolidation, corrigenda, version and relevance to UK law.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: HUDOC and other international decisions affecting UK obligations or interpretation.
classes.label: European human-rights and international decisions
classes.minimum_provenance: Court/body, application number, date, status, language and UK relevance.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Rules and decisions of legal-services regulators and professional bodies.
classes.label: Professional rules and legal-services regulation
classes.minimum_provenance: Regulator, authorised-person class, rule version, effective date and statutory basis.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Historical records, archived websites and digitised material outside current publication systems.
classes.label: Archival legal records and web archives
classes.minimum_provenance: Archive reference, series, date range, digitisation status, custody and access restrictions.

classes.definition_and_legal_force: Law reports, citators, textbooks, practitioner commentary and news.
classes.label: Secondary reporting and commentary
classes.minimum_provenance: Publisher, edition, licence, editorial method and clear non-official status.
